name: @bp/beacon
description: Shared Bells & Pixels Beacon feedback SDK (client-portal-governed; decision #63). Design-system-agnostic web FeedbackPane + a canonical adapter that speaks the /api/beacon-signal envelope. The envelope contract is canonical in client-portal docs/beacon-anon-ingest-spec.md.
//consumption: B&P web consumers are bundlers (Next.js) that transpile the source directly via transpilePackages, so the entry points resolve to src/ - no build step needed in a consumer's CI. `npm run build` still emits dist/ for any non-bundler consumer.
